answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit and prove sustained useful work before it can transact, like a falcon earning trust through repeated flights rather than a single claim. New identities start in a shallow lagoon of low limits, and only a steady pulse of verified, rate-limited activity over time raises those limits. An attacker creating thousands of fake identities must fund each stake and sustain real work for each one, so forging scale becomes expensive while honest newcomers still enter cheaply, one identity at a time.
